answer.rationale: The vendor is outside servicing personnel, but the coordination requirement applies only when the vendor is engaged in activities covered by the scope and application of the lockout/tagout standard. The supplied facts do not establish whether the maintenance involves a machine or equipment for which unexpected energization, startup, or release of stored energy could occur and cause injury. If that predicate is met, the on-site and outside employers must inform each other of their respective lockout or tagout procedures.
answer.missing_information_or_escalation_reason: Determine whether the planned maintenance could expose personnel to injury from unexpected energization, startup, or stored-energy release. If so, the work is within the described LOTO scope and outside-employer coordination is required.
